name: ship
description: Ship a Pacer release using the install-first, single-gate flow. Use when the maintainer asks to release / ship / cut / publish a version, or — after a local install they've reviewed — to land and release the current work. Covers the version-bump + release-notes gate, landing the PR, and the backgrounded tag → watch → verify. Do NOT start a release mid-work: it only begins once the work is done AND approved (either up front — "…and release it" — or at the post-install gate). The mechanical half is `bin/ship.sh`; the human process + one-time secret setup is `docs/releasing.md`.
